items.title: Insurance Age reports Broker M&A hit near decade low in October
items.summary: Insurance Age reported that broker mergers and acquisitions reached a near decade low in October.

items.title: Aon expands automatic follow-form facility share to 35% for 2027
items.summary: Aon has renewed and expanded its automatic follow-form facility for 2027, increasing its coverage share to 35% from 28.5%.

items.title: Fidelity Asia Pacific Opportunities loses Titan Square Mile rating
items.summary: Titan Square Mile has withdrawn its A rating from the Fidelity Asia Pacific Opportunities fund following the departure of manager Anthony Srom.

items.title: Sheila Cameron to step down as CEO of Lloyd’s Market Association
items.summary: Sheila Cameron is leaving her role representing managing agents at the LMA in the new year after leading the organisation since 2019.

items.title: Commercial e-trading software requires greater broker challenge, say tech leaders
items.summary: SSP UK and Ireland and IS2 executives argue that commercial lines brokers must push technology providers harder on product access, referrals and self-service capabilities.

items.title: BTPS funding improves with deficit falling by £1bn
items.summary: The BT Pension Scheme has agreed its 2026 triennial valuation with BT Group, showing a reduced deficit and outlining additional funding requirements.
